scope: Background-only module and receive-admission checks; no live browser/transport/UI execution
receiveCases: private altered ciphertext with valid outer signature
private altered nonce with valid outer signature
direct altered ciphertext with valid outer signature
direct altered nonce with valid outer signature
receiveAssertions: Reject altered payload; accept same-ID original once afterward; reject duplicate original. Network/traffic-panel mocked; DOM rendering absent.

mutations.scope: Owned temporary copies only; removed in finally
mutations.private: authentication-failure branch returns an unauthenticated sentinel
mutations.direct: authentication-failure branch returns an unauthenticated sentinel
mutations.result: Real decryptor returns null; mutant returns sentinel; positive original decrypts in both. Malformed-length probes are not claimed as mutation kills.

limitations: Not live private/direct tampering acceptance; earlier public browser tampering evidence is separate.
Not a proof of cryptographic security or detection of every possible fail-open defect.
Chrome diagnostic plan prepared only; root cause remains unresolved.
Website copy validated statically and through Flask in-process rendering; no new visual layout run.
Receive-module rejection does not isolate decryption authentication from inner parsing/signature checks; primitive checks and mutation control exercise the decryptor separately.
Direct-message ephemeralPubKey tampering, including small-order inputs, is not covered by these new tests.
